keyDecisions: P3 Scenes UI is wired as the ACTIVE-SCENE CONTROLLER over EditorState (NOT the retired SceneManager stub). Switching the active scene (setActiveScene) is enough for the viewport/QuadList/Inspector to follow, since they all read es.quadManager()/activeScene().

One-scene-per-output is enforced in the Scenes UI assignment dropdown AND on load remap, because OutputManager::sceneForOutput returns the FIRST scene matching an output (a shared output would be ambiguous).

P4 previews render in the MAIN GL context via a single shared Renderer (not the per-output contexts), into a 320x180 RAII Framebuffer per output; updatePreviews saves/restores the framebuffer binding + viewport. The per-output Renderers stay for real perform-mode output.
P4 did NOT revive the reference PreviewPanel from 669a05c^ - it was an interactive vector editor overlapping ViewportEditor. P4 ships a true FBO thumbnail of what each projector shows.

.qmap v3 (ADR-039): writer emits scenes[]+outputs[] only when the project carries scene DTOs; a flat-only Project still writes legacy v1.2 (byte-clean, keeps old files/tests compatible). Unified reader yields >=1 scene for v1 (flat->1 scene) / v2 (scenes->list) / v3 (+outputs). kMaxSupportedMajor 2->3.

EditorState owns live scenes (Scene/QuadManager) and OutputManager owns outputs; Project is the serialization DTO with new SceneData/OutputData structs. syncEditorToProject/syncProjectToEditor are the single save/load bridge; load rebuilds outputs (v3) and remaps each scene's assignedOutputId onto the freshly created live output ids.
UUID() default-constructs to NULL (0,0); use UUID::generate() for a fresh id. This bit the serializer first draft (scene/output ids stayed null) - fixed.

Smoke harness robustness: pin the QUADmapper window TOPMOST at (0,0) (the Claude desktop app kept stealing foreground and the window drifted run-to-run, breaking hardcoded click coords) + AttachThreadInput foreground-steal. Click coords are read from cropped screenshots; SetCursorPos uses PHYSICAL pixels (capture is 2560x1440 physical though Screen.Bounds reports 2048x1152 logical at 125%).

lessons: When reviving retired code as a reference (ADR's listed PreviewPanel/SceneManager from 669a05c^), CHECK WHAT IT ACTUALLY DID before wiring it - the reference PreviewPanel was an interactive vector editor (overlaps ViewportEditor), not the FBO thumbnail P4 needed. Shipped the right thing instead of blindly reviving.

Protected .qmap boundary: keep the writer emitting the OLD format for the OLD shape (flat-only Project -> v1.2) and only emit the new format for new data (scenes -> v3). This keeps every existing file + round-trip test byte-compatible while adding v3 - no migration of existing files needed.
UUID() is NULL, UUID::generate() is fresh - a subtle default-ctor trap that left serialized scene/output ids null until caught by the round-trip test asserting a non-null assignedOutputId.

Foreground-stealing apps (Claude desktop) + run-to-run window drift make hardcoded synthetic-click coords flaky. Pin the target window TOPMOST at a fixed origin (0,0) for deterministic coords; re-assert focus before every click.
